text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: P1 - model-catalog service. Trigger: tokenizer mismatch during inference. Incident ID PD-8921. Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall and pager duty. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8921

pagerduty-bot: PD-8921 assigned to @jordana (on-call). Please acknowledge. Escalation path will run in 5m if not acked.

jordana: ack. I'm on it — quick summary pls, what's failing?

mike: seeing spikes in 500s from /v1/generate for model catalog:catalog-2026.03.14. Error in logs: TokenizationError: vocab_size mismatch (expected 50257 got 30000). Recent catalog config pushed at 1750001000 set default_revision to "latest".

alina: reproducer attached in staging: tokenizer for rev-latest-2026 uses different vocab file. stack trace:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/infer/runner.py", line 212, in handle_request
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(request.input)
  File "/opt/models/tokenizers/fast_tokenizer.py", line 44, in encode
    raise TokenizationError(f"vocab_size mismatch: {len(self.vocab)} != {self.expected}")
TokenizationError: vocab_size mismatch: 30000 != 50257
```

emma: CS report - two customers flagged wrong outputs (ACME, BrightData). ACME saw truncated/garbled summaries; one support ticket created: SUP-1319. Billing unaffected.

jordana: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert model-catalog default to pinned rev that was serving at 1749999000 (rev-42). 2) disable auto-rollout for catalog. 3) run smoke tests. I'll trigger rollback now.

mike: running rollback command on control-plane: 
```bash
redwoodctl model-catalog update --name catalog --default-revision rev-42 --disable-auto-rollout 
redwoodctl deploy --catalog catalog --revision rev-42 --target serving --wait
```

mike: rolling back... invoking job job-cc93. kubectl rollout restart deployment/catalog-serving -n redwood-inference

mike: rollback completed, canary checks passed (3/3), no 500s in canary. Promoting to all.

incident-bot: Auto-check: /v1/generate 500 rate dropped from 12% -> 0.4% after promotion. Continuing monitoring for 10m.

alina: initial RCA: a config push earlier set default_revision: "latest" which picked up a new revision produced by external model conversion pipeline. That conversion used a different tokenizer (SentencePiece) with vocab 30k, incompatible with our standard BPE expectation. The config change lacked the tokenizer-compatibility gate.

jordana: customer impact: intermittent wrong output for any request using catalog:latest between 1750001100-1750001220. Estimate affected requests ~1.2k, impacted accounts 2-5 (high-value). Escalate CS outreach.

emma: CS: I'll send immediate notifications to ACME and BrightData with incident summary and mitigation. Draft message: "We're sorry — we observed incorrect outputs for requests using catalog:latest earlier today. We've reverted to a pinned revision and are monitoring. A follow-up postmortem will be shared." Want approval before sending.

jordana: approved. Add note to include support ticket IDs and offer priority support call.

mike: temporary guard added to control-plane: block deploys where tokenizer.vocab_size != service.expected_vocab_size. Patching pre-deploy hook now.

alina: long-term fixes: 1) pin default_revision in catalog to explicit hashes, 2) add tokenizer-compat check in CI + control-plane preflight, 3) add unit test to conversion pipeline to verify vocab size and tokenizer type, 4) update runbook. I'll file RFC for model onboarding changes.

jordana: created incident follow-up ticket INC-2026-45 and assigned to eng-runtime (mike) and eng-ml (alina). Link: https://redwood.atlassian/incidents/INC-2026-45

mike: adding additional alert: if TokenizationError > 0 for >1% of requests in 5m, page eng-oncall. Also added dashboard tile showing tokenizer mismatch rate per model revision.

emma: CS outreach sent to ACME and BrightData; awaiting replies. Logged in SUP-1319 and SUP-1320.

jordana: handoff: I'm going offline for 30m to coordinate CS. @mike you take on-call if anything else fires. Handoff timestamp 1750001290.

mike: oncall ack, monitoring. Will follow up on INC-2026-45 and preflight patch.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8921 marked RESOLVED by @jordana after mitigation and rollback. Postmortem required within 48h.

jordana: thanks everyone. Quick notes for postmortem: bad default value (latest), missing tokenizer compatibility gate, conversion pipeline produced incompatible artifact, gap in preflight checks. I'll start draft in #postmortems and link to INC-2026-45.
